description: 350 original GB Quest boss encounter definitions. Creature taxonomy follows the 14 classic D&D creature types; class/subclass roles and names are original game data, not official D&D stat blocks.
challengeRatingNote: CR is a tuning target, not a complete D&D stat block. Encounter stats, actions and legendary actions must be authored and playtested separately.
